if: the supply is a supply of services under forward charge
the invoice is NOT issued within the period prescribed under s.31
then: this limb yields the EARLIER of the date of provision of service and the date of receipt of payment
note: Issuing the invoice late does not delay the tax point — it moves it BACK to the date the service was provided. This is the opposite of what a late invoice intuitively suggests.
